name: South Ocean Holdings Limited
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from the issuer unaudited summarised consolidated interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, statement of profit or loss, unit R thousands multiplied by 1,000. Revenue less cost of sales equals the printed gross profit 75905. Operating Expenses of 45811 is administration expenses 29517 plus distribution expenses 6536 plus the printed operating expenses 25622 plus the movement in the credit loss allowance 1198 less other operating income 17062, so gross profit less that line equals the printed operating profit 30094. Net finance costs 15795 equals finance costs 16369 less finance income 574. Profit before tax less taxation 3861 equals the printed profit for the period 10438. Net Profit is the total for the period; 16300 attaches to the parent and a loss of 5880 to non controlling interests, and the printed EPS of 8.02 cents is the parent figure. || Yahoo Finance | CRON 20261025_155306: period columns and blank cells synchronised between the SOH and SOH.JO keys from whichever of the two already held the verified figures (same company name and currency, no value overwritten where the two disagreed); no new figure was collected in this step.
